features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F Main Unit; power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
Compact bullet-style design for indoor ceilings and walls
Camera angle adjustment: pan ±180, tilt 0 to 90, rotation ±90
Detachable 8 m cable to the main unit
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (ds_f1004_bullet_t10073766_en_2010.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded.
